profile.headline: Full-stack developer with 7+ years of experience in modern web & mobile apps. Expert in React Native, Next.js, Vercel & Node.js. Focused on building high-performance applications & solving complex problems.
profile.summary: Software Engineer from Los Angeles, CA.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Telstraight Inc. is a wholesale distributor of IT products. I worked on a team as a front end developer on a custom drop-shipping system.

- Building interface for drop-ship system with Next.js

positions.title: Full Stack Javascript Developer
positions.description:
Magma Products is a manufacturing company in the marine industry. I developed, deployed, maintained and provided support for their e-commerce Node application.

- Build custom CMS with React
- Build public facing frontend with pug, SASS, and jQuery
- Design REST API to update internal inventory systems
- Build custom integrations and e-commerce features with third party APIs
- Automate tasks with Node CLI tools
- Unit testing with Mocha and Jest
- Error tracking with Sentry

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
- Responsible for the management of teaching artists and students, and communication between partners, executive staff, administrators, and parents
- Develop google sheets add-on for parsing student attendance
- Build a web app for teachers to check-in with google scripts
